This text is introducing *Fighting Back*, a temporary newsletter from *The Guardian* that will run until the U.S. presidential inauguration. It features advice from experts on how to defend civil liberties and freedoms under a potential Trump presidency. Readers are encouraged to sign up if interested.

The article then offers practical advice for taking action: start by calming yourself (deep breaths, walks, meditation, talking to loved ones). Once ready, write a personal mission statement about an issue you care about. Think about how different levels of power—local, state, federal, corporate, and societal—connect to your chosen problem. This helps you plan how to address it effectively.

In short, it’s a call to prepare mentally, define your goals, and strategize how to make a difference in challenging times.
